jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

What will you do?

• Clean the interiors of tankers, bulk trucks, container trucks and other vehicles.
• Operate a forklift to move materials and goods.
• Ensure that cleaning orders are carried out correctly.
• Carefully monitor the work during cleaning activities.
• Refill cleaning products in a timely manner.
• Perform general cleaning and maintenance of the workplace.
• Comply with applicable safety and quality regulations.
• Work together with colleagues to complete cleaning assignments efficiently.

Who are you?

• You are characterised by motivation, a willingness to learn and a hands-on mentality.
• Speaking Dutch, English or German is not a problem for you.
• Good physical fitness is important, as this is a physically demanding job; candidates must not suffer from back problems.
• You are comfortable working at heights or in smaller, enclosed spaces.
• Working safely and using the necessary personal protective equipment is second nature to you.
• Experience operating a forklift is required; a forklift certificate is an advantage, but not essential.
• You do not wear glasses, or you are willing to wear contact lenses.
• Basic knowledge of computer programs is an advantage.
• You are able to work both independently and as part of a team.
• Accuracy and a strong sense of responsibility are among your strengths.
• Your own means of transport is essential, as the workplace is not accessible by public transport.
• Experience in industrial cleaning or the cleaning sector is an advantage, but motivation is the priority.

The Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH will manage pricing and tender processes within the life sciences industry, ensuring accuracy and compliance. This role is focused on delivering high-quality customer service support.

Client Details

Our client is an international company active in medical supplies and accessories.

They are looking for a temporary (but with probability of becoming permanent) Tender & Pricing Coordinator who is fluent in German and English.

Description

As a Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH you will have two main pillars:

 

1) Pricing

 

• You analyse pricing strategies and habits in your markets and develop the company's pricing structure
• You make sure prices get approved and implemented
• You communicate new price quotations to your customers
• You are responsible for implementing your pricing in SAP
• You update price catalogues
 

2) Tender & Sales Support

 

• You manage tender processes from A to Z (preparation, analyses, contracts, pitches, ...)
• You communicate important contract changes
• You monitor the tender renewals
• You analyze clients complaints regarding contracting and pricing
 

 

 

 

A successful Pricing & Tender Coordinator DACH should have:

• Experience in tender, pricing and customer service or administrative roles
• Knowledge of pricing and tender processes
• Strong organisational and multitasking skills
• Attention to detail and accuracy in handling documents
• Proficiency in IT tools, particularly Excel and SAP
• Fluency in English and German
• Ideally your are immediately available

jobs.description:

You’ll interact with international clients through various channels – calls, emails, and chat – providing accurate, friendly, and timely support.

Ready to take the next step in your career? If you have strong language skills, a commitment to delivering excellent service, and thrive in a fast-paced, multicultural environment, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a valued member of our international customer service team in Liège!

• Excellent command of English, both spoken and written

• Successful completion of an English language assessment

• Strong communication and customer service skills

• Good computer literacy and ability to learn new systems

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural environment

• Fluency in one or more of the following language combinations: Dutch + English, German + English, German + English + French, or German + English + Dutch

• Additional language skills may qualify for a language bonus

• Upper secondary education completed

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

As a 1st Line Customer Support Agent, you are the first point of contact for customers, handling inquiries via phone and/or ticketing system. You will provide technical support and customer service for users in transportation products and services.

Your primary goal is to deliver accurate and timely support to customers, aiming to resolve issues efficiently or escalate them when necessary. You will also support product installations and validations.

This is a time-sensitive role, requiring prompt and clear communication to ensure customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Handling incoming support calls (triage), ensuring all calls are addressed

• 
Managing support tickets in the assigned language queue(s) on a First-In, First-Out (FIFO) basis

• 
Performing initial analysis of reported issues

• 
Conducting validation calls and following up with installers

• 
Processing Return Authorization (RA) tickets

• 
Following escalation procedures and adhering to support policies

• 
Communicating effectively with customers across various channels

Desired Skills and Experience : 

• 
Fluent in Dutch, French, English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally in both spoken and written form

• 
Comfortable working in an IT and software-driven environment

• 
Strong organizational skills, with a proactive and reliable attitude

• 
Eagerness to learn new products and procedures

• 
Previous experience in a customer support center is a plus

Industrial investment projects in a process environment

In this role, you lead complex multidisciplinary CAPEX projects within an industrial process setting from start to finish. You retain full responsibility throughout the project lifecycle for scope, budget, timing, quality and safety. The assignment covers both greenfield initiatives and substantial modifications to existing industrial installations.

Key responsibilities

• Lead industrial engineering projects from feasibility and concept phase through commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Set and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and the baseline schedule in MS Project.
• Steer all project stages, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, on-site execution, commissioning and transfer.
• Serve as the main accountable point of contact for stakeholders and management during the full project trajectory.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary internal and external teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS domains.
• Control scope changes, project risks, claims and deviations with impact on cost or planning.
• Provide clear reporting on progress, decisions and issues to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You have at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also bring at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval processes and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Experience in the process industry is required.
• You have strong hands-on expertise in MS Project and are used to building and owning project schedules, not just tracking them.
• You work at academic level and combine strong analytical capabilities with a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work autonomously and take full ownership of your assignments.
• You demonstrate strong leadership and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when necessary.
• You communicate confidently with stakeholders at every organisational level.
• You bring natural authority to complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

Are you ready to step into a Finance Controller role where your experience truly counts from day one?
Apply now and bring your expertise to an organization shaping the future of mobility.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an international organization active in Aftermarket services for advanced mobility systems, we are looking for a Finance Controller who can step in quickly and make an immediate impact. The company focuses on the sales, service, and technical support of advanced powertrain, transmission, and chassis technologies for passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and industrial applications. From Brussels, they support mobility solutions delivered worldwide.

Your role

As a Finance Controller, you play a key role in ensuring financial transparency, control, and insight across the organization. This is a plug-and-play role: you are operational from day one and work autonomously with limited onboarding.

Your responsibilities include:
	
• Monthly, quarterly, and yearly financial reporting	
• Budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis	
• Analysis of costs, margins, and performance	
• Supporting management with financial insights and decision-making	
• Ensuring compliance with internal procedures and external requirements	
• Preparing audits and improving internal controls	
• Acting as a sparring partner for operational and technical stakeholders

Your profile
	
• Bachelor or Master degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics	
• 5+ years experience as Finance Controller or similar role	
• Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow	
• Excellent Excel skills and experience with ERP systems	
• Able to work independently and accurately in a complex environment	
• Hands-on, proactive, and pragmatic mindset	
• Comfortable in an international and technical context	
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English

Got a first working experience, and looking to expand your horizons? As a Junior Customer Service Representative for the Emerging Markets at a multinational medical devices and healthcare company, you'll be the primary point of contact for their valued customers (hospitals, distributors, buying groups, ...).

What you'll do:

• Order processing, either manual or via an internal platform
• Maintain various master data (customers, prices, materials, ...) in SAP in order to ensure data accuracy and streamline processes to keep the data up to date
• Address customer concerns by executing root cause investigations and offering solutions (replacements, corrective invoices, ...)
• Issue credit/debit memos
• Support inventory management activities

• You're fluent in English and intermediate to proficient in either Russian, French or Arab
• You have a first experience in a similar role
• Upper secondary diploma/high school diploma
